'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Markey DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Markey]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Incomplete player name as written. Sheet title It took Jake and I 4 hrs to make this piece of poop... Starting interrupt There Is No Try package; objective inferred from Death Star War Room / Conference Room / KDY package.

* '''Player:''' [[Markey]]
